title: Message marked complete even if processing fails
description: BufferedConsumer marks messages as 'completed' (ack) regardless of whether on_flush actually succeeded. If the flush callback raises an exception, the message is still removed from the buffer, causing silent data loss.
prompt_hint: Messages silently disappearing from the processing queue after flush errors

title: queue.Queue has no shutdown method in Python < 3.13
description: Code calls queue.Queue.shutdown() which was only added in Python 3.13. Running on Python 3.12 or earlier raises AttributeError, breaking the graceful shutdown path.
prompt_hint: AttributeError: 'Queue' object has no attribute 'shutdown' during process termination

title: Nested dict access without null checks on error_sampling context
description: Accessing nested dictionary keys in the error_sampling context without checking for None first. When contexts or error_sampling are absent, the code raises AttributeError.
prompt_hint: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'get' in error sampling pipeline

title: timezone.now() called at class definition time instead of runtime
description: A default value uses timezone.now() at class definition time, meaning the timestamp is fixed when the module loads rather than being evaluated fresh for each instance.
prompt_hint: Scheduled tasks all share the same stale timestamp from server startup

title: datetime in Celery kwargs fails JSON serialization
description: Passing a datetime object directly in Celery task kwargs causes JSON serialization failures since datetime is not JSON-serializable by default.
prompt_hint: TypeError: Object of type datetime is not JSON serializable when dispatching Celery tasks

title: kill() without checking if process is alive
description: The code calls os.kill() on a process without first verifying it is still running. If the process already exited, this raises ProcessLookupError or OSError.
prompt_hint: ProcessLookupError: [Errno 3] No such process during shutdown sequence

title: Shutdown flusher processes not terminated
description: During shutdown, flusher child processes are not properly terminated, leaving orphaned processes that hold resources and prevent clean exit.
prompt_hint: Orphaned flusher processes still running after main process exits

title: Abstract class missing abstract method implementations
description: A concrete class inherits from an abstract base class but fails to implement required abstract methods, causing TypeError at instantiation.
prompt_hint: TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class with abstract methods

title: DetectorPriorityLevel to PriorityLevel enum mismatch
description: Code maps between two enum types (DetectorPriorityLevel and PriorityLevel) but the mapping is incomplete or uses wrong values, causing KeyError or incorrect priority assignment.
prompt_hint: KeyError or wrong priority level when converting between detector and issue priorities

title: _truncate_title called on wrong class
description: The _truncate_title method is called on an instance that doesn't have it (wrong class or missing inheritance), causing AttributeError.
prompt_hint: AttributeError: object has no attribute '_truncate_title' when creating issue titles
